description: Controlled vocabulary for the finality_basis Tier-3 conditional field. Required when event.finality == 0 (rule FB-001). Declares the mechanism by which a pending-finality event will eventually reach settlement.

entries.name: Optimistic Window
entries.description: Settlement is pending the expiry of a fraud-proof challenge window. Typical for optimistic rollups (e.g. Optimism, Arbitrum, BASE). finality_eta SHOULD be provided as the Unix timestamp at which the challenge window closes.

entries.name: Probabilistic Finality
entries.description: Settlement is probabilistically final pending additional block confirmations. Risk of reversal decreases monotonically with confirmation depth. Typical for proof-of-work chains (BTC, ETH pre-merge legacy paths). finality_eta MAY be provided as estimated confirmation count or block height.

entries.name: Legal Appeal Window
entries.description: Settlement is pending expiry of a statutory appeal period or the exhaustion of available legal remedies. Applies to court orders, arbitral awards, and administrative acts that are subject to appeal. finality_eta SHOULD be provided as the ISO 8601 date of the earliest appeal deadline.

entries.name: Custodial Clawback Window
entries.description: Settlement is subject to a custodian's contractual or regulatory right of reversal or clawback within a defined period. finality_eta SHOULD be provided as the Unix timestamp at which the clawback window closes.

entries.name: Staking or Yield-Bearing Lock
entries.description: Movement or settlement is constrained by an active staking, delegation, restaking, liquidity, or yield-bearing lock. Use when an asset is attempting to move while locked, or will become locked once moved. finality_eta SHOULD be provided as the unlock timestamp, epoch, or block height where deterministic.

entries.name: Vesting Schedule
entries.description: Movement or settlement is constrained by a token, token-fraction, equity, or real-world asset vesting/release schedule. finality_eta SHOULD be provided as the next release timestamp, schedule milestone, or block height where deterministic.

entries.name: Protocol Pending
entries.description: Settlement is pending a protocol-defined condition that is not otherwise captured by another finality_basis value. Use when no more specific basis applies. SHOULD be accompanied by a human-readable explanation in event metadata.
